title: Turnkey Design-Build
summary: Single-point accountability from preliminary feasibility study, drawings, BOQ, material procurement to final snag-free handover.
deliverables: Itemized bill of quantities (BOQ) with fixed material assumptions
Weekly site progression milestones with photo logs
Handover defect inspection and 12-month workmanship support

title: Architecture & Space Planning
summary: Functional, structurally sound architectural layouts tailored to Delhi NCR municipal norms and site constraints.
deliverables: 2D layout plans, elevations, and structural drawings

title: Interior Architecture & Fit-Out
summary: High-craft interior solutions including false ceilings, electrical layouts, civil alterations, and bespoke cabinetry.
deliverables: Lighting design (3000K-4000K mood and task illumination)
Surface finish coordination (veneer, stone, micro-cement, tile)

title: Nishawe Bespoke Furniture
summary: Custom furniture manufactured in our dedicated facility, built to exact project room scales and fabric selections.
deliverables: Hardwood frame sofas, sectionals, and ergonomic accent chairs
Custom storage beds, hydraulic lift mechanisms, and upholstered headboards
Modular TV consoles, dining tables, sideboards, and temple units
